setting.note: In the pleasure-loving Paris of the late Second Empire, a music-hall actress turned courtesan rises from the boulevard theatres to a mansion of her own, ruining a string of wealthy men on her way.

rights.originalWork: Public domain. Émile Zola, first published 1880; the author died in 1902. Mapped here as a cited work: we store none of its text and reproduce no passages. The places are facts and the notes are our own.

palette.note: The hothouse rose of the demi-monde, glamour with rot underneath. A rich, decadent tone that clears WCAG AA on paper.
